verdict.rationale: The evidence only hints at campaign analytics. The AI can 'analyze performance' and 'analyze your workspace', it can run scheduled 'broadcast recaps' and 'deliverability reports', and the App API can 'fetch data'. That implies performance data exists, but no citation describes per-campaign or per-step reporting. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of open, click, unsubscribe and conversion metrics; per-automation-step breakdowns; time-series or over-time reporting; conversion goal attribution; independent or hands-on corroboration.
